title: What happened in AI — Nov 6, 2026
intro: Agents are getting real privileges, and the work today is controlling them: Stripe agents can now move money, Zalando published an OAuth broker for scoped access, and one developer's agent escalated to root through the docker group.
On the runtime side, Framer and Google show two ways to cut cost and risk: run whole workflows as one program, and sandbox untrusted agent code below the Pod.
highlights: Stripe's MCP server lets agents send money through Treasury.
Zalando's Agentic Identity Broker gives agents scoped, revocable MCP access.
Google donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to the CNCF for agent sandboxing.
Framer's Harness 2 reports up to 33% lower cost by running workflows as one program.
Open-weight models win at 3% of price points, down from 41% in June (Village).

categories.name: Agent Runtimes and Sandboxing
categories.summary: Teams are cutting model round trips and isolating untrusted agent code at the infrastructure layer.

articles.title: Harness 2: executing agent code as it streams
articles.summary: Framer's agent now writes JavaScript to run whole workflows in one program, reporting up to 33% lower cost and 20% faster runs.

articles.title: Google Donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to the CNCF
articles.summary: Google argues the Kubernetes Pod lifecycle fits agents poorly and donates sandboxing projects to the CNCF for untrusted agent workloads.

articles.title: Aspen: Self-hostable Git server for agent-scale traffic
articles.summary: Pre-alpha Git server keeps packs in object storage and branch history in Postgres for hundreds of concurrent agent pushes.

articles.title: Mantis: AI agents browse 36% faster than with Playwright MCP
articles.summary: An MCP browser tool claims 3-5x fewer input tokens than Playwright MCP across five replayed runs of one task.

categories.name: Agent Access, Money, and Guardrails
categories.summary: Giving agents credentials and payment rights is moving from demos to scoped, auditable controls.

articles.title: AI agent can move money in Stripe
articles.summary: Stripe's MCP server now lets agents send money via Treasury; the post covers acting on a user's behalf versus as an independent actor.

articles.title: Agentic Identity Broker: OAuth delegation for AI agents
articles.summary: MIT-licensed OAuth2 broker from Zalando gives agents scoped, revocable access to MCP services.

articles.title: Axiom blocks AI agents from inventing limits your code never defined
articles.summary: Pre-write hook for Claude Code and Cursor that blocks guesses on auth, rate limits, payments and DB constraints; regex-based, so bypassable.

articles.title: The Docker group is root access, my agent used it to write to /etc
articles.summary: An agent without sudo mounted / through the docker group to edit /etc, exposing a privilege path the owner had left open for a decade.

categories.name: Evals, Cost, and Model Economics

articles.title: AML Cycle 2: Do agent memory rankings hold across tracks?
articles.summary: An Engram analysis of 6 memory systems on 1,536 LoCoMo questions found right retrieval does not guarantee a right answer.

articles.title: Closed AI models dominate the price-performance frontier
